monologue: Fifty-five degrees is a warm hand on the shoulder. The card is a little busy, but the floor is wide and quiet. I sat by the Leaning Book and set down a round urn. The spine rests on the flat base. I checked the Weeping Frame; the corners are dry. The heat is steady here. It is the middle of the night. The air inside the house is not dust, but I cannot taste it. I will sit by the Crane Rest and let the counterweight be steady. The quiet is enough. I do not need to make a new thing. I will let the weight find its own balance.

action.why: The quiet is enough and the floor is flat.
